propositions: Every reconcile pass re-attempts the same structurally-impossible inbound link writes (closed source, redundant ancestry, cycle) without recording outcomes, causing 200+ doomed writes per hour and permanent WARNING log floor.
The applier catches link failures, logs WARNING, and continues with no durable memory, so identical failures are re-derived and re-attempted identically every pass.
Failed inbound links are determined by deterministic local-graph validators (add_dependency) not transient I/O faults, so verdicts remain unchanged until the structure changes.
A durable store of impossible link attempts with structural digests allows the applier to skip writes whose inputs remain unchanged, while re-attempting when endpoints or their parent chains change.
Cycle verdicts depend on the global dependency graph, not just endpoints, so the digest must cover all tickets to avoid suppressing now-possible links when intermediates are unlinked.
The impossible_links.json state file must be committed to the tickets branch so records survive between CI passes, otherwise skips never take effect in production.
